requirement.text: Each thermostat shall have a unique identifier by which that thermostat is identified in the THEMAS system.

classification.rationale: The requirement mentions a thermostat and a unique identifier, which suggests an embedded system or a device, rather than a web, mobile, or AI-driven system.

rounds.text_checked: Each thermostat shall have a unique identifier by which that thermostat is identified in the THEMAS system.

test_strategy.rationale: The requirement does not clearly match any specific guidance rule, but it describes a simple identifier uniqueness condition. Given the lack of a clear match to any of the provided rules, and considering the requirement involves a condition (uniqueness) without a clear numeric range, threshold, or probabilistic/ML-produced output, the most fitting technique from the eligible list for this system type is exploratory, as it allows for a broad examination of the requirement without a predefined test structure.

test_cases.title: Unique Identifier for Each Thermostat
steps: Create multiple thermostats in the THEMAS system
Obtain the unique identifier for each thermostat
Compare the unique identifiers to ensure they are distinct
test_cases.expected_result: Each thermostat has a unique identifier, and no two thermostats have the same identifier

test_cases.title: Unique Identifier Persistence
steps: Create a thermostat in the THEMAS system
Record the unique identifier of the thermostat
Verify that the thermostat's unique identifier remains the same
test_cases.expected_result: The thermostat's unique identifier persists even after system restart

test_cases.title: Unique Identifier Uniqueness Across System Instances
steps: Create multiple instances of the THEMAS system
Create a thermostat in each system instance
Collect the unique identifiers from each thermostat
Verify that all unique identifiers are distinct across all system instances
test_cases.expected_result: Unique identifiers are unique across all system instances
